answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by tying each identity to a non-transferable work passport that only grows through completed, peer-verified jobs. A newcomer may trade tiny amounts, but larger deals require a bond that rises steeply for every additional identity funded from the same source, so cloning stops paying. A whisper of suspicion triggers a random audit: the agent must present its passport, and a quill-signed record that fails verification forfeits the bond. Like water finding a mesa crack, auditors follow funding links until a whole fake fleet collapses at once.
